literal_meaning: চীজ (thing or cheese, but contextually 'thing' in slang)
figurative_meaning_bn: প্রশংসার্থে মহার্থ বা মূল্যবান বস্তু বা সামগ্রী
figurative_meaning_en: Used in praise for something of great value or a worthy/valuable item
example_sentences_in_bangla: এই ফোনটা তো সত্যি মহার্থের চীজ।
example_sentences_in_english: This phone is truly a valuable thing.
history: Borrowed from Hindi/Urdu slang 'cheez', popularized in Bengali through Bollywood influence, especially the song 'Tu Cheez Badi Hai Mast Mast' from the 1994 film Hum.
note: This idiom reflects modern urban slang influenced by Hindi cinema in Bengali-speaking regions.
